svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a flat blanket of three films, a thick silver one between two thin purple ones, covers a pale oxide with two small tungsten plugs in it, over buried metal lines. After it three violet resist lines stand on the blanket, two of them over the plugs.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a flat blanket of three films, a thick silver one between two thin purple ones, covers a pale oxide with two small tungsten plugs in it, over buried metal lines. svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the metal reticle and
developed, leaving lines wherever metal is to remain.
After: resist lines on the stack
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
